in_sanskrit.meaning: ज्योतिर्वज्रावलयक्ता (ज्योतिर्वज्रा = Goddess of Lightning, वज्रलक्ता = bearing the thunderbolt)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who bears the goddess of lightning's thunderbolt

in_hindi.name: ज्योत्स्विका
in_hindi.meaning: ज्योतिर्वज्रा वाजिनी (ज्योतिर्वज्रा = Goddess of Lightning, वाजिनी = riding a chariot drawn by horses)

in_tamil.name: ஜயோத்ச்விகா
in_tamil.meaning: ஜயோதிர் வாழ்த்தியர் (ஜயோதிர் = Goddess of Lightning, வாழ்த்தியர் = goddess)

in_marathi.name: Jyotsvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Light and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotsvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyotsvika is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Jyot’ meaning light and ‘Svika’ meaning prosperity. This name is often given to girls to represent the Goddess of Light and Prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Jyotsvika is believed to bring good fortune, wisdom, and prosperity to those who bear this name.
